svg.title: Commercial diver — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as commercial diver, wearing a protective suit and protective goggles. Visible work cue: A tall air cylinder connects through a visible upper hose to a separate round breathing regulator and mouthpiece. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: protective goggles.
